Enumerate vector

enum.Rd

This function enumerates the values of an input vector x, counting along the length of the vector from 1 to length(x).

Usage

enum(x, inPlace = TRUE, sep = ":")

Arguments

x

The input vector to enumrate.

Must be a vector (either atomic, or a list()).

inPlace

Should the numbers be pasted onto the original vector?

Defaults to TRUE.

Must be a singleton logical value: an on/off switch.

sep

Separator between numbers and vector.

Defaults to ":".

Can be empty string (""), if no separator is desired.

Details

If inPlace = TRUE (and x is atomic), the original vector is returned with the counts pasted to the front of each value, separated by sep. If inPlace = FALSE, a new integer vector is returned, identical to calling seq_along(x).

Examples


enum(letters)
#> Error in enum(letters): could not find function "enum"
enum(letters, inPlace = FALSE)
#> Error in enum(letters, inPlace = FALSE): could not find function "enum"
